description: Placental abruption can harm mother and baby. Injury to the uterus, commonly a car accident or fall, can cause this emergency condition.
shortAnswer: Abruption (breaking away or off) of the placenta can be harmful to the mother and baby and in rare cases even lead to death. Injury to your uterus (commonly a car accident or fall) can cause this emergency condition. If your baby was harmed in this way, you may want to evaluate your legal options.

faq.q: Why is placental abruption dangerous for an unborn baby?
faq.a: The placenta is your baby's life support system until birth. The majority of the placenta must stay attached to the uterus or your baby will not receive enough blood, oxygen and nutrition and could die.
